name: Snowmobile
summary: Snowmobile in side view with a front ski and a rear track; the track turns when it drives. For snow scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the ski and the track stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 750 px wide and 270 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = track rollers turn and the machine bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the ski faces left

author: krakujs
